Reviewed actual source in /Users/addomam/projects/amux-acp-build, including the uncommitted integration, rather than treating HEAD c8808f3 as the implementation. 24 input route gating/no replay—inspected active-ACP key/paste/mouse/focus/resize/double-prefix handling, native-input fallback guards, and transport-uncertainty behavior; 25 local queue rejection recovery—checked return of the original unqueued envelope and exact original-binding-only restoration; 28 lock order/no blocking I/O under locks—traced target-to-broker/state ordering, released topology projections, event draining, and outside-lock spawn/write/wait/join; 29 observable regression quality—read real-peer effects, held-response barriers, negative-effect checks, cleanup/sentinel assertions, and current captured PTY recovery/queue frames; Evidence assessment: inspected the actual captured inspect-recovery and queue-status frames, not merely their success flags. They show retained total42 history and local draft, followed by deliberate same-session total57/count2 and completed canonical work without the stale busy/not-queued chrome. Reviewed the supplied resume-smoke frames and CLI-only label rejection record. These are parent-produced evidence, not independently reproduced results. The reported 341 workspace tests and strict checks were not rerun or relabelled as this review's verification.

No concrete attacker-controlled source-to-authorization bypass, identity confusion, terminal execution, unrelated-process signal, or plaintext high-value credential disclosure survived inspection and the required exclusions. Resource-only denial-of-service, same-user executable/cwd/environment choices, agent-owned tool behavior, speculative races/hardening, dependency age, and log spoofing were not promoted into security findings. No actionable Fowler smell was identified in the reviewed security-critical paths.

Supplied test counts, cleanup observations, terminal-mode restoration, and PTY scenarios remain parent-produced evidence; no independent runtime or adversarial terminal-injection proof is claimed.

Forms/permission selection, later complete-broker acceptance, real adapter/provider/model/auth compatibility, project-close UX, and the pre-existing native terminal application fence are outside this frozen s01 scope. Reviewed unsupported-request behavior and cancellation handling only as currently exposed; no approval of future functionality or a sandbox boundary is implied.

The supplied source manifest and branch/base context were used to identify the candidate. File hashes were not independently recomputed, and no Git commands or index operations were performed. The schema pin/lock entry was inspected, but a separate transitive dependency vulnerability audit and upstream schema implementation audit were not performed.

Process cleanup was assessed from the owned-session implementation and existing boundary tests, not by inducing an actual OS process-metadata outage or exercising Darwin/Linux process timing. The in-flight startup regression drives the real consumer ordering boundary but is memory-only; it is not independent real-child late-publication proof.
